assumptions: ideal battery with no internal resistance
ideal capacitor and resistor, no leakage
connection made at t = 0 with capacitor uncharged

TC3C7.regime: Opening the switch matters only if it happens before the 80 ms observation time; at 500 ms > 80 ms the charging up to 80 ms is unaffected.

T821E.regime: Disconnection matters only if it happens before 80 ms; at 500 ms it is after the observation time.

notes: With the added 2 kOhm series resistor R = 7 kOhm, tau = 0.14 s, t/tau = 0.5714, e^{-0.5714} = 0.56472, V = 12 * 0.43528 = 5.223 V. Variant groups: TD847/T97FD/T01DF/T3BFD all state 2 kOhm; TC3C7/T821E both state 500 ms. They differ only in attachment as intended. TD847 and T01DF are both relevant variants (two wordings of the same series insertion). Minor: 'connected in series between the battery and the capacitor' could in principle be read as replacing nothing, which is the natural reading; no ambiguity in effect.
